runs.name: Essential Utilities, Inc.; NYSE WTRG, SEC CIK 0000078128, formerly Philadelphia Suburban Corp and Aqua America Inc, renamed 2020; Pennsylvania holding company of regulated water, wastewater and natural gas utilities serving about 5.5 million people in nine states under the Aqua and Peoples brands, two segments, Aqua Pennsylvania about 57% of water revenue; all-stock merger into American Water Works signed 2025-10-26 at 0.305 AWK a share, approved by both shareholders 2026-02-10, not closed, PaPUC joint petition for non-unanimous settlement 2026-09-15; $500M of 5.125% notes due 2036 issued 2026-03-09; the 10-K names no rival that files, American Water Works, American States Water and California Water Service chosen as a CONVENTION of the run
runs.box: OUT AT Q7, ON THE FLOOR
runs.entry: The v5 re-run order, unattended work-hours cycle, one dispatched analyst under the canonical brief, from scratch. The brief's departures: the repository path after the move of 2026-10-25; the lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the FY2025 10-K's Items 1, 1A and 7 (rate allowances, surcharges and Pennsylvania's fair-market-value acquisition law; the two segments and Aqua Pennsylvania's weight; competition for acquisitions and from other fuels; the $8.7B capital plan; EPS against rate base; gas use, explosion and climate risks; Pennsylvania concentration; $8.3B of debt and the capital markets; the merger and its $370M termination fee; rate base $12.4B); competitors chosen by the analyst as a CONVENTION because the 10-K names none, municipal systems flagged as not SEC filers. Price **$42.45** (2026-10-28, aggregator, flagged; the 0.305 AWK consideration about $43.04 on a day-old AWK quote) x **283,778,605 shares** (10-Q cover, 2026-07-27, accession 0000078128-26-000077; one class; checked against issued less treasury at 2026-06-30) = cap **$12,046.4M**; sovereign **5.30%** (Treasury 30-year par, 2026-10-27). tools/run.py's owner-earnings window stopped at FY2018 and was not used; owner cash built from the filed cash-flow statements. **Q1 IN** (water decides, 61% of the two segments' net income 2021 to 2025, $1,710.2M against gas $1,095.0M). **Q2 IN on the regulated franchise** ("little competition for the daily ... service"; ordinary regulator-set returns carried to Q3 as a second best; standing risk the regulatory compact, concentrated in Pennsylvania); five-year average ROE 2021 to 2025 WTRG 9.17% against AWK 11.86%, AWR 13.91%, CWT 8.28%, rivals' figures XBRL transcriptions flagged. **Q3 weighs against** (capital spending 3.45 times depreciation; added plant about 6.7% pre-tax). **Q4 weighs against, no STOP** (tax regulatory asset $1,897M from repairs flowed through to customers; EPS guidance, pay-plan EPS target "Achieved" 2023 to 2025). **Q5 IN on integrity, ability weighs against mildly** (no restatement or material weakness; the one adjusted figure lowered 2024 EPS from $2.17 to $1.97). **Q6 weighs against** (about $2.1B retained or raised over five years while market value fell about $0.7B; dividends paid while stock is sold; pay on rate-base growth; the all-stock STOP not engaged, WTRG being the target). **Q7 OUT, on the floor and above the top of the range**: equity-only central (a regulated utility); owner cash FY2021 to FY2025 after the depreciation guess **$430.7M a year**, -$424.1M after all spending, negative every year; customer advances and contributions credited against spending, a CONVENTION of the run; shown growth 14.57% cut under (f) to sales growth 7.14%; growth spending $915.8M in year one to $1,703.3M in year ten; utility debt credit $396.7M a year, below the cap of 53.67%, the business's own long-term debt share because the filing states no allowed capital structure. Value range **$28.63 to $32.98 a share equity-only (central)**; 3.57% to 4.48% at the price, 6.91% even on the uncut growth; **fair price $13.00 equity-only, central**; $13.95 with the alternative credit beside; all-equity -$11.24, not positive; the signed deal stated beside and not valued (it would mean valuing American Water). Facts after the stop recorded, not weighed. Balance sheet ten year-ends: equity up $5.0B of which $3.76B new stock; goodwill $64M to $2,325M with Peoples in 2020; non-current long-term debt $1.7B to $8.1B, about 1.18 times equity; cash near zero; pre-tax interest cover about 2.9 times in 2025. Strongest evidence against, as the analyst put it: no owner cash after spending in five years, funded by new stock and debt every year; reported income running ahead of a full-tax figure through the flow-through tax asset; about a dollar of new capital for each dollar of growth at a regulated return. Framework gaps for the operator: whether regulated replacement spending is maintenance; the growth measure for a utility (owner cash swung by gas-cost working capital, revenue including passed-through gas cost; rate base not named); specific (c) when the run's company is the target of an all-stock deal. Could not get: the allowed ROE and capital structure (black-box settlements); the amounts requested in the rate cases; rivals' figures from their filed statements; the value of the AWK consideration; a split of replacement and growth spending. Analyst's commits: pathspec commits of its own paths after each question or pair (Q3 with Q4, Q5 with Q6), Q7 with the Q6 write-back in `c222d6da`, a clarification in `a0378719`. Dispatcher's check: check_framework PASS; no E-ids, every id in the ledger, no citation slip, 55 adjacent fragment pairs checked by `dispatcher_cite_check.py`, none flagged; no tracked research file over 200 KB. Contamination declared: a Test Runs listing showing the names of today's AWK, AWR, CWT, CTAS and INOD runs and folders, CWT commit subjects with its box, range and fair price at session start, and memory index lines; none used. Position note filled at the fold: not held. Armed at the equity-only fair price.
runs.narr: OUT at Q7 on the floor: a Pennsylvania water and gas utility, the target of a signed all-stock merger into American Water, whose castle is the regulated franchise, earning 9.17% on equity over five years and never producing owner cash after spending, funded by new stock and debt every year; maintenance owner cash about 3.6% of the price; value range $28.63 to $32.98 equity-only against $42.45. Fair $13.00 equity-only, central; all-equity not positive; armed.

Run 2026-10-28 (Test Runs/2026-10-28 Run - WTRG Essential Utilities.md; OUT at Q7 at $42.45; equity-only value range $28.63 to $32.98). Reporting figure; any price below fair is read as cheap by the operator; a hit means re-run, not a buy.
